title: Finite torsion Tate twists are etale locally free lines
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $N\geq1$ be an integer invertible in every local ring of $T$, and let $A$ be a finite commutative ring with $NA=0$. Work on the small etale site $T_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], with constant sheaves $A_T$ and $(\mathbf Z/N\mathbf Z)_T$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], their module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and the sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Let $\mu_{N,T}$ be the sheaf of abelian groups $U\mapsto\{z\in\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)^\times:z^N=1\}$, with its $\mathbf Z/N\mathbf Z$-module action $a\cdot z=z^a$. Define $A_T(1)=\mu_{N,T}\otimes_{(\mathbf Z/N\mathbf Z)_T} A_T$, $A_T(0)=A_T$, and $A_T(r)=A_T(1)^{\otimes_{A_T}r}$ for $r\geq1$. Then for every $r\geq0$ there is an etale covering $\{T_i\to T\}$ with $A_T(r)|_{T_i}\cong A_{T_i}$ as module sheaves. In particular these sheaves are locally constant [def-constructible-locally-constant], locally free of rank one, and flat: tensoring with them preserves exact sequences of module sheaves.

proof.text: First identify the scalar extension in [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-twist] with the existing extension of an abelian sheaf: an additive map between ZMod N modules is automatically ZMod N-linear (AddMonoidHom.toZModLinearMap). The two extensions have naturally identical Hom equivalences against restriction of scalars. Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq gives zmodScalarExtensionIso, and sheafification gives finiteEtaleLineAbIso. Both comparisons are completely proved private helpers, with no new obligation.

The stalk hypothesis makes N a global unit by RingedSpace.isUnit_of_isUnit_germ. Apply the existing primitiveRootsCover to Gamma(T,O_T) and pull it back along T.toSpecGamma. Its etaleness, surjectivity, distinguished root and unit power differences are supplied by the completely proved source module WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.PrimitiveRootsCover, using [lem-sc-primitive-root] for separably closed residue fields. This yields a singleton etale cover of T, without an affine-open covering refinement. The private helper exists_first_twist_cover explicitly constructs this cover and root.

Over the cover use the proved source isIso_constantZModToRootsOfUnitySheaf_of_isUnit_sub (WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Sites.RootsOfUnityConstant): the distinguished root identifies the roots sheaf with the constant cyclic sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Pullback of roots along an etale map is identified by isIso_upperStarRootsOfUnitySheafToRootsOfUnitySheaf. upperStarExtendScalarsIso and extendScalarsConstantZModIso carry this to a trivialization of the finite twist line from step 1. The scalar condition is precisely hA; no flatness of A over ZMod N is used.

For positive degrees, induct on n for degree n+1 using the recursive tensor product [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-twist], the monoidal pullback comparison, tensorIso, and the left unitor. Degree zero uses the pullback unit isomorphism. These are the canonical sheaf tensor products [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Transport the pullback trivialization through Etale.overSheafEquiv and constantSheafSheafCongrIso to obtain the exact localized-site isomorphisms in the theorem. Sheaf.isConstant_of_iso then supplies LocallyConstantDatum and [def-constructible-locally-constant].

Use the existing completely proved source tensorInverseOfUpperStarIso on the same jointly surjective cover and the degree-r trivializations. Its rightIso identifies the twist tensored with its internal dual with the monoidal unit. ObjectProperty.flat_of_tensorIso makes tensorLeft an equivalence, so it preserves finite limits and colimits. This avoids the former tensor-stalk and exact-conservative-stalk argument entirely. The relevant APIs are WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.Etale.UpperLowerStar.LocallyTrivialInverse and WeilConjectures.CategoryTheory.Abelian.Flat.Basic; no new lemma or sorry is introduced.
